summary: A 1929 gable-roof cupola cabin in the Kootenai National Forest, abandoned in 1948 and restored in 1983; a recent assessment found it in good condition. Current access is unclear.

facts.design: Gable-roof cupola cabin, 12x14 ft, shake and frame
facts.agency: Kootenai National Forest, U.S. Forest Service

visit.trail_note: Nearly a 2-mile hike after remote forest roads; seasonal road conditions at high elevation (Campflare).

events.note: Listed as a camp at the site
12x14 ft shake and frame gable-roof cupola cabin
Restored to serviceable condition by the Kootenai National Forest; the register says it reopened as a KNF rental
Volunteer condition assessment: good overall; future work on specific structural issues plus ongoing maintenance

evidence.supports: built 1929, 12x14 shake and frame cabin, abandoned 1948, restored 1983 as a KNF rental
evidence.quote: Built in 1929, the 12' x 14' shake and frame cabin was abandoned in 1948 but survived and was restored in 1983 as a Kootenai National Forest rental.
There are a few hip roof cupola lookouts remaining, and even fewer gable roof models (although they once were common in Montana and northern Idaho).

evidence.supports: site hard to reach and often fogged in
evidence.quote: A high elevation site and located a few miles south of the Canadian border, the lookout was difficult to reach and often fogged in.

evidence.supports: camp listed in 1921, cabin 1929, abandoned 1948, restored 1983
evidence.quote: 1921: camp. 1929: 12x14' shake cupola cabin. Abandoned in 1948. Restored 1983.

evidence.supports: located in the Kootenai National Forest
one of the few remaining gable-roof cupola lookouts, once common in Montana and northern Idaho
evidence.quote: Robinson Mountain Lookout is one of the few remaining gable-roof cupola lookouts, a style that was once common in Montana and northern Idaho.

evidence.supports: elevation 7,404 feet, a few miles south of the Canadian border
evidence.quote: It sits at an elevation of 7,404 feet, just a few miles south of the Canadian border.

evidence.supports: restored to serviceable condition in 1983 by the Kootenai National Forest
evidence.quote: Built in 1929, the 12-by-14-foot shake-and-frame cabin was abandoned in 1948 and restored to serviceable condition in 1983 by the Kootenai National Forest.

evidence.supports: volunteers with Ksanka Ranger District staff conducted the assessment
evidence.quote: Volunteers Gary Weber (National FFLA Treasurer) and Chuck Manning conducted the assessment, with assistance from Ksanka Ranger District employees Marcy Goheen and Traci Swope.

evidence.supports: good condition, future structural work plus ongoing maintenance
evidence.quote: Overall, the structure remains in good condition, though it will require future attention to resolve specific structural issues alongside ongoing maintenance.

evidence.supports: not listed on Recreation.gov, may be used without fees, access uncertain
evidence.quote: Robinson Mountain Lookout is not currently listed on Recreation.gov for reservations. The site may be available for use without fees, but current accessibility is uncertain due to seasonal road conditions at high elevation.

evidence.supports: nearly 2-mile hike after remote forest roads
evidence.quote: Access requires a nearly 2-mile hike after navigating remote forest roads.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says the 1983 restoration reopened the cabin as a Kootenai National Forest rental. The association says the forest restored it to serviceable condition. Both agree on the year and on the forest's role.

notes_for_editor: Record's 2022 'needs a little help' assessment was not found in any page read, so it is left out of events. Current rental status and access were not confirmed, so the access key is omitted. Campflare is a third-party aggregator and is the only source for the hike distance. The NHLR and the association pages differ on how the 1983 restoration was run, shown in resolved_conflicts. The record's coordinates (48.96666, -115.411785) differ by roughly 40 m from the firelookout.org listing (48.96703, -115.41202); not changed. A September Facebook post from the association on the assessment has no year and was not used.
